about: The figures of the gallery page (site/pages/gallery.astro) and the home page. scripts/gallery.mjs runs each entry through the openreadout binary on the public corpus files and writes public/img/gallery/NAME.png and site/data/gallery.json. $CORPUS is the corpus directory. Entries with `preview` are `openreadout preview FILE ARGS...`; `objects` counts objects with `stats --objects` and previews the plane with a point on each; `plot` is the spec of `openreadout plot`.

entries.name: slide-fold
entries.title: Labelled layers in a whole-slide scan
entries.caption: One fold of the cerebellum in a 3.7 GB slide scan of a young mouse, read as a 1,200 × 900 pixel region. The rulers are file pixels, so an agent can read coordinates off the picture and put its labels where it sees the layers.

entries.name: growth-grid
entries.title: A kinetic plate read in plate positions
entries.caption: A plate reader's 96 growth curves, each in its well's place and coloured by the plate layout's groups, with the blank wells faint.

entries.name: spikes
entries.title: Action potentials marked on a sweep
entries.caption: A current-clamp sweep of a fast-spiking interneuron with `--marks spikes`.

entries.name: spectrum
entries.title: A mass spectrum with its peaks labelled
entries.caption: One scan of an Orbitrap run converted to mzML. The largest peaks carry their m/z.

entries.name: run-quality
entries.title: A sequencing run at a glance
entries.caption: An Illumina NovaSeq 6000 run folder read from its InterOp metrics only: % of base calls at Q30 or above by cycle per lane with the reads marked, intensity and base composition by cycle, cluster density and pass filter per lane, and the Q-score distribution.

entries.name: squiggle
entries.title: A nanopore read, raw
entries.caption: One read of an Oxford Nanopore PromethION POD5 file in picoamperes: the whole read, a zoom where single bases show as steps, and where the read sits among the file's read durations.

entries.name: read-lengths
entries.title: Read lengths and qualities of a FASTQ file
entries.caption: PacBio HiFi reads: the length histogram with the N50 marked, the mean read quality and the quality by position, streamed from a gzip FASTQ.

entries.name: flow-density
entries.title: Flow cytometry as a density plot
entries.caption: Two fluorescence parameters of an FCS file on asinh axes.

entries.name: plate-grid
entries.title: 96 growth curves, flagged as they grew or crashed
entries.caption: Blank-subtracted growth in plate positions. A colour rule at 6 h splits the wells into those that grew and those that crashed or held back, and the row and column headings come from the plate layout.

plot.title: Plate 1: growth in every well
plot.caption: Phage per well. Data: Refardt, Bergmiller & Kümmerli, Dryad, CC0.

entries.name: comeback
entries.title: Group means with a band
entries.caption: The mean of the infected wells against the uninfected ones, with a band where the cultures came back.

plot.title: Mean of the HK97 wells with and without phage
plot.caption: Mean ± SD; 8 wells without phage, 36 with.

entries.name: tic-spectrum
entries.title: A TIC and the spectrum at its apex
entries.caption: Two panels from one file: the total ion current with its apex labelled, and the mass spectrum at that retention time.

plot.title: Caffeine run: the TIC and the spectrum at its apex

entries.name: fi
entries.title: An f–I curve and the sweeps behind it
entries.caption: Spikes per current step from the patch-clamp analysis, next to four sweeps with their spikes marked.

plot.title: Fast-spiking interneuron: firing grows with current

entries.name: fcs-gates
entries.title: Gated populations from a FlowJo workspace
entries.caption: The CD4+ and CD8+ populations of a FlowJo workspace drawn over the events of one tube.

plot.title: T cells in tube E01: CD4 and CD8 populations

entries.name: ir-overlay
entries.title: Spectra stacked, with their bands labelled
entries.caption: Four ATR-FTIR reference spectra from OMNIC files, offset so each stays readable.

entries.name: nmr
entries.title: An NMR spectrum processed from the FID
entries.caption: The free induction decay of a Bruker experiment, Fourier transformed and phased, with the water signal marked.

entries.name: qpcr
entries.title: qPCR amplification on a log axis
entries.caption: Every well of an Applied Biosystems run, one colour per target.

entries.name: dose-response
entries.title: Dose-response fits with their IC50s
entries.caption: Four-parameter fits of three compounds from a plate and its layout file.

entries.name: chromatograms
entries.title: Chromatograms as small multiples
entries.caption: Three PDA chromatograms from AIA/ANDI files, one small plot each on a shared time axis.

entries.name: diffraction
entries.title: A diffraction image with resolution rings
entries.caption: One image of an EIGER 2X 16M sweep (NeXus master and bitshuffle-compressed data file), shrunk by the maximum so single-pixel spots survive, with log contrast, the module gaps as no data and resolution rings from the recorded wavelength, distance and beam centre.

entries.name: cryoem-micrograph
entries.title: An electron-event movie summed into a micrograph
entries.caption: All 648 frames of a Falcon 4i EER movie added up into the dose image, with the power spectrum of its middle as an inset: apoferritin particles at a carbon edge, and the Thon rings that tell the defocus.

entries.name: tilt-scheme
entries.title: The dose a tilt series collected, tilt by tilt
entries.caption: A SerialEM tilt series' metadata: each tilt's accumulated dose against its angle shows the dose-symmetric order, 0° first and then alternating outwards.
